top.title: Briggs & Stratton keeps the lights on longer with bigger 16 kWh LFP battery
top.summary: For decades, Briggs & Stratton has helped keep the lights on after the storm with its gas-powered generators. Now, the company is bringing that legacy to the electric age with a new 16 kWh backup battery designed to scale with your growing energy needs. more…
